description: Example folded unadapted RNAGenesis sequence selected from the Stage 1 poster-config run.
selection_rule: Example folded unadapted RNAGenesis sequence selected from the Stage 1 poster-config run using a deterministic rule: (1) load stage1_all_sequences.csv; (2) when a condition column is present, keep only rows with an explicit label containing 'unadapted' and 'rnagenesis' (exclude rows with missing condition values); (3) prefer stage1_pass == True; (4) require valid A/C/G/U alphabet and non-empty sequence; (5) require non-trivial dot-bracket structure with at least four '(' and four ')'; (6) among passing sequences, sort by normalised_mfe ascending (more negative first); (7) take the 10th–25th percentile slice by normalised_mfe to avoid the single most extreme outlier; (8) within that slice, choose the sequence with smallest absolute distance from GC target 0.6165, breaking ties by sequence_id ascending.
